Consts

PluginStorage = r"PluginKitStaticReaders"
This cache table stores the contents of files read at compile-time.

Macros

macro embedStaticFiles(basepath: static string;
                       paths: static openArray[(string, string)])
A macro that reads file contents at compile and bundles them into the plugin binary as a static resource, so they can be accessed/processed at runtime via PluginManager's API. 
macro register(key: untyped; config: static JsonNode)
A macro that serializes a Nim data structure (e.g. a table or object) into a JSON string at compile time and stores it in a cache table, so it can be accessed/processed at runtime via PluginManager's API. 
macro registerTemplates(basepath, path: static string)
A macro that reads template file contents at compile time and stores them in a cache table, so they can be accessed/processed at runtime via PluginManager's API.
